findings.title: Review access control on a record

explain.story: A person could read a record that was not theirs.
explain.why_it_matters: Private information may be visible to the wrong person.
explain.mistake_pattern: The application did not check who owns the record.
explain.prevention_rule: Check ownership before returning private records.
explain.ai_prompt: Check that each person is allowed to read a private record before returning it, and add tests for allowed and denied access.

patch.diff:
--- a/target/app.py
+++ b/target/app.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def get_record():
-    return record
+    check_access(record)
+    return record
patch.summary: Add an access check before returning a record.
